item.title: Arclight researchers detail zero-day flaw in popular VPN appliance as vendor ships patch
item.description: Security firm Arclight disclosed a zero-day vulnerability in a widely deployed VPN appliance that attackers used to gain remote access. The vendor has released a patch and urged customers to update immediately.
